scripts.dev: bun run build:notch && ELECTROBUN_BUILD_ENV=dev RA_NOTCH_DIR="$PWD/../notch" RA_PORT=13690 RA_UI_PORT=13691 concurrently -k "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:ui" "electrobun dev"
scripts.build:server: bun run --cwd ../ui build && bun run --cwd ../api ui-manifest && rm -rf dist-server && bun build ../api/src/index.ts --target=bun --outdir dist-server --external playwright --external playwright-core
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run build:server && bun run build:notch && electrobun build
scripts.build:stable: bun run build:ui && bun run build:server && bun run build:notch && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.release: osascript -e 'quit app "Remote Agent"' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pkill -f '/Applications/Remote Agent.app' 2>/dev/null; bun run build:stable && bun run install:app && open '/Applications/Remote Agent.app'
